correctedCritiques.pro-consciousness-with-reduced-or-absent: Strongest feature: The examples challenge oversimplified proportionality between neural activity and consciousness, connecting human and plant phenomena to the central consciousness-first bridge. Principal limitation: Decision, memory, adaptive behavior, phenomenal consciousness, reduced neural tissue, and absent material processing remain insufficiently distinguished, while verification and distributed-biological alternatives receive compressed treatment. Live burden: Jones must establish consciousness in the cited systems, distinguish reduced or unconventional processing from no material processing, and explain why these cases favor idealism over physical realization through alternative architectures. Locked score: The mixed band reflects empirical relevance, recoverable examples, and a challenge to simplistic brain models, counterbalanced by unstable terminology, overstated calibration, rival-analysis limits, and the unresolved inferential gap between unusual biological function and materially independent consciousness.
correctedCritiques.pro-top-down-mental-causation: Strongest feature: The argument combines psychedelic phenomenology with attention-related neural plasticity, challenging simplistic activity-production models while providing empirical support for the central consciousness-first bridge. Principal limitation: Reduced activity in selected measures may accompany altered network organization, while top-down psychological description remains compatible with materially implemented causation and cannot independently establish consciousness-first ontology. Live burden: Jones must specify neural measures, exclude reorganized physical processing, and derive contrasting predictions showing that idealist mental causation outperforms physicalist accounts of attention, training, and psychedelic experience. Locked score: The strong/competent band recognizes coherent relevance, concrete evidential direction, and qualified plausibility, while registering slightly overstated warrant, partly unstable top-down terminology, incomplete alternative testing, and an unresolved bridge from explanatory level to metaphysical priority.
